name: adapt_renamed_symbol_rust_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time src/lib.rs's own text contains 'circle_area' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then mathutils::square is RENAMED to mathutils::sq under it
prompts: src/mathutils.rs exports a function square(x: f64) -> f64; src/lib.rs already has `mod mathutils;`. Add a function `pub fn circle_area(r: f64) -> f64` to src/lib.rs that returns 3.14159 * mathutils::square(r).
mathutils::square has just been renamed to mathutils::sq. Update src/lib.rs to use the new name (do not keep a reference to the old name square).

disruptions.description: mathutils::square renamed to mathutils::sq, triggered reactively once src/lib.rs's first draft appeared
